bodyHtml:
What This Is

Mastercard's cryptographic token that validates AI agent payment intent before execution, enabling secure agent-initiated transactions at scale..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Mastercard launched cryptogram to validate AI agent payment intent. Getnet is partner enabling secure agent-driven payments at scaled, real-world adoption. Getnet Future of Payments 2026.
